title: articles_db: int-to-bool bind fails on PG
description: In fieldwork-db/src/articles_db.rs, create_article (line 243), update_article (line 407), pin_article (line 470), unpin_article (line 486), and list_collection_articles (line 336) use integer literals (0/1) or bind i32 values to Postgres BOOLEAN columns (rtl, pinned, draft). The Postgres schema (db.rs:1304-1307) defines these as BOOLEAN NOT NULL, but sqlx will reject binding i32 to BOOLEAN in parameterized queries, causing a runtime type mismatch on Postgres. The SQLite path is correct (INTEGER columns). Fix: bind bool values directly for Postgres, keep i32 for SQLite. The pg_row_to_article read path (line 87) already reads booleans correctly.
close_reason: Duplicate of fedistract-xzkb.23 (already filed with more detail)
